weakness: OT remote access is password-only with full gate and unit control; no MFA for privileged OT access (IA-2(1) findings tracked here)
remediation_plan: Interim: after-hours remote HMI set to view-only; gate and unit commands only from the control room or local panels. Then a DMZ jump host with MFA from the identity provider, named accounts, and session recording
milestones: 2026-09-15 view-only interim in place; 2026-11-30 MFA jump host live for operators; 2026-12-31 OT VPN profile removed

weakness: Shared operator account; no account procedure, monitoring, or quarterly review; termination not aligned with OT
remediation_plan: Rotate the shared password now; named operator accounts on the HMI; OT step on the termination checklist; quarterly review by the Plant Manager
milestones: 2026-09-10 shared password rotated; 2026-10-15 termination checklist updated; 2026-11-30 named accounts live; 2026-12-31 first quarterly review

weakness: Dual-homed engineering workstation and broad corporate-to-OT rules bypass the DMZ; flat control LAN
remediation_plan: Remove the corporate interface; allow-list firewall rules (historian replication and jump host only); separate gate and unit VLANs
milestones: 2026-09-30 second interface removed; 2026-10-31 rule rebuild; 2027-03-31 VLAN separation

weakness: Vendor remote maintenance is always on, unapproved per session, single-factor, and unlogged
remediation_plan: On-demand vendor sessions through the jump host with approval by the Plant Manager or shift supervisor, MFA, recording, and weekly review; remove the resident vendor tool
milestones: 2026-10-15 vendor contracts amended; 2026-12-31 always-on connections removed

weakness: No OT component inventory or criticality record
remediation_plan: Build the OT inventory (hardware, firmware, software, connections, Section 9 criticality) from the passive scan and a walkdown
milestones: 2026-11-15 draft for the Cyber/SCADA annex; 2026-12-31 complete

weakness: PLC logic and HMI backups irregular, unprotected, and on the same network
remediation_plan: Backups after every change and monthly to an offline write-protected copy and the cloud vault with immutable retention; integrity hashes
milestones: 2026-10-15 full current backup set taken; 2026-11-30 offline and vault copies routine

weakness: No OT contingency plan or restore test
remediation_plan: OT contingency and recovery procedure; annual restore test on a spare PLC and virtual HMI

weakness: No review of OT audit records
remediation_plan: Daily command-log review by the shift supervisor; weekly VPN and vendor session review by the Controls Engineer; logs to the cloud workspace with 1-year retention
milestones: 2026-10-31 manual daily review starts; 2027-01-31 workspace forwarding

weakness: No OT security monitoring; unauthorized device on the control LAN went undetected
remediation_plan: Passive OT network monitoring sensor with alerts to the shift supervisor; detection rules in the log workspace; legal review of monitoring

weakness: No OT vulnerability assessment ever performed
remediation_plan: Outside OT vulnerability assessment (passive and bench testing), then every 12 months; remediation deadlines by risk

weakness: No OT patch process; SCADA servers on an unsupported operating system
remediation_plan: Quarterly review of vendor-approved patches with the integrator; SCADA platform upgrade to a supported operating system

weakness: No role-based control system security training
remediation_plan: Annual OT security module before OT access; ICS security course for the Controls Engineer and I&C technicians

weakness: CEII (drawings, inundation maps, network diagrams) readable by all staff
remediation_plan: Restricted CEII library with named members and labels; remove CEII from general shares

weakness: Default passwords on 2 gate panels and 2 gauge modems; shared password unchanged; passwords written in the control room binder
source: P07 (IA-5, new finding); P01 R-011, R-012
remediation_plan: Change default passwords; private APN for the modems; remove the binder; lost-authenticator procedure
milestones: 2026-09-30 gate panel passwords changed; 2026-10-15 modems on a private APN; 2026-11-30 procedure
resources_required: Staff time; carrier fee $600 per year

weakness: Gate and unit commands cannot be tied to a person
remediation_plan: Named operator accounts (same work as POAM-002)

weakness: No security impact analysis or change records for OT changes
remediation_plan: OT change log with security impact review (POL-01 4.9); 3-year record retention

weakness: Removable media uncontrolled on OT machines; unowned USB drives found
remediation_plan: Removable media rule (POL-05 4.4); scanning kiosk; USB port control on HMIs and the engineering workstation
milestones: 2026-09-15 unowned drives removed; 2026-11-30 kiosk and port control

weakness: OT incident handling not exercised; no forensic support; no lessons-learned process
remediation_plan: Tabletop with the sheriff, county emergency management, and the FBI field office; OT incident response retainer through the cyber insurer

weakness: Cyber events not named as 18 CFR 12.10 conditions; staff unaware of cyber reporting; no HSIN account
remediation_plan: Update the ODSP reporting section and POL-03 briefings; HSIN Dams portal membership; suspicious activity procedure

weakness: FERC Security Plan not reviewed or updated since 2022; no IT/SCADA section; electronic copy in a general share
remediation_plan: Update the Security Plan and Security Assessment, add the Cyber/SCADA annex from the P02 SSP, move copies to the CEII library; corrected statement to the Regional Engineer
milestones: 2026-09-30 corrected statement and plan and schedule sent; 2026-11-15 updated plan and assessment

weakness: 2 gate panel enclosure keys missing from the key register and inventory
remediation_plan: Add keys to the register; rekey if any key cannot be accounted for
